gate: component paper: surface-EMG-to-speech system comparing four mapping methods
version: Reviewed text: the IEEE/ACM TASLP 25(12) article, author-hosted PDF (see source_article.meta.json). The wiki folder holds the 2016 KIT dissertation; the former notes.json (now notes.dissertation.json) was built from the dissertation and was replaced by notes rebuilt from the article.
prep: no prep/ directory; plan and audits built by the writer from four published topic tables, append-only (dated keys suffixed with the slug)
time_frame: first public 2017-11 (IEEE online 2017-11-23; issue 2017-12). Prior = before 2017-05; [concurrent] = 2017-05 to 2018-05.
setting: One setting across slots: speech decoding or synthesis from non-acoustic speech-production signals measured on the speaker; lip video only together with such signals. The group's earlier papers (Toth 2009, Zahner 2014, Diener 2015) count as prior designs of the same group, not as versions of the target. M06 uses the surface-EMG subset of this setting.
